topics.purpose: Define approved exact expected output/snapshot artifacts with identity, target/test scope and byte/semantic comparison profile.

semantics.identity_rule: Each golden artifact has an explicit identity/revision.
semantics.update_rule: Golden updates are candidate changes requiring review/acceptance.
semantics.drift_rule: Observed mismatch creates finding rather than silently rewriting golden.
semantics.authority_rule: Golden artifact is test evidence, not production source-of-truth.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: test automatically updates golden on failure
semantic test uses byte compare accidentally
